name: REPUBLICAN STATE LEADERSHIP COMMITTEE
allocation_note: Amounts past this donor's own gifts are the reported totals between the two parties, not this donor's share. Once money is pooled in a committee it is fungible, so how much of it reached any spender or ad is not determinable.
method: Forward walk over the same money edges as the chain walk (Schedule A receipts and committee-to-committee transfers from FEC bulk data, refunds excluded), starting from REPUBLICAN STATE LEADERSHIP COMMITTEE: the 1 committee(s) it gave to in the 2024 cycle, then the outside spenders in this race that received transfers from those committees (1 spender(s) reached), then each spender's independent expenditures for or against a candidate. Independent expenditures are targeting edges: they move no money to the candidate and are drawn separately. Amounts on money edges are the reported totals between the two parties, not a share of this donor's dollars — once pooled, a donor's money is fungible, so no allocation is made past the first hop. `total_given` is the sum of the first-hop edges shown (itemized receipts reported under this name); `total_in_chains`, used only to rank donors, sums this donor's edges across every spender chain in the race, so the same gift counts once per chain it appears in.
